question: Should ClawHub support unscoped default-skill aliases for OpenClaw bundled names like `coding-agent`, or should setup require owner-qualified official refs?
rationale: The source behavior is understood, but the safe fix depends on whether maintainers want official short-name aliases, owner-qualified defaults, or no short-name guarantee for default skills.

options.title: Use owner-qualified defaults
options.body: Publish and verify official `@openclaw/<slug>` targets, then update setup/CLI guidance to use those refs so community slug collisions cannot be selected silently.

options.title: Reserve short aliases
options.body: Create a reserved default-skill alias path for selected names, with ownership and moderation checks before any short name resolves to an installable artifact.

options.title: Document short names unsupported
options.body: Keep unscoped names ambiguous or missing and make setup/help text direct users to search or owner-qualified refs instead.

recommendation.title: Use owner-qualified defaults
recommendation.body: Publish and verify official `@openclaw/<slug>` targets, then update setup/CLI guidance to use those refs so community slug collisions cannot be selected silently.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sits on the owner-scoped skill API, CLI install, and CODEOWNERS-listed backend/CLI surfaces where Patrick has the strongest recent history.
